findings.where: PR list table, # column (all nine rows, 4821 to 4865)
findings.evidence: The PR numbers render in a pale tint almost the same as the card background and are barely readable in both shots. The row identifier is effectively missing, so a reviewer can't tell which number to select. The cause is the button's `text-accent` class at diff.patch line 112. The numbers only show up faintly as ghost text.
